(path: string): boolean =>
	SYSTEM.some((d) => path === d || path.startsWith(`${d}/`))

args
		.slice(0, end < 0 ? args.length : end)
		.filter((a) => a.startsWith("-") && a !== "-")

(
	name: string,
	args: string[],
	redirected: boolean,
): boolean =>
	(name === "tee" && !flagsOf(args).includes("-a")) ||
	(redirected &&
		(name === "printf" ||
			name === "echo" ||
			(name === "cat" && operands(args).length === 0)))

[
		packageVerdict(name, args, has),
		writeTargets(c, name, args).some((p) => PLUGIN_HOOKS.test(p))
			? ask(GATE_HOOK_WRITE)
			: undefined,
		writesWhole(name, args, redirected) ? deny(GATE_WRITE_FILE) : undefined,
		!(c.from || c.into || redirected) && printsFile(name, args)
			? deny(GATE_READ_FILE)
			: undefined,
	]

[
		upstreamVerdict(command, parsed.commands),
		...parsed.commands.flatMap((c) => commandVerdicts(c, has)),
	].filter((v) => v !== undefined)

(f) =>
		f.type === "PathExists"
			? []
			: [{ wanted: f.type === "Matches", test: new RegExp(String(f.value)) }]

(w, i) =>
		end >= 0 && i > end && w.startsWith("-") ? `./${w}` : w

(text: string, feed: Rule["feed"]): Rule[] =>
	rules
		.filter(
			({ rule, test, filters }) =>
				rule.feed === feed && test.test(text) && filters(text),
		)
		.map(({ rule }) => rule)

rules
		.filter(
			({ rule, test, filters }) =>
				rule.feed === feed && test.test(text) && filters(text),
		)

({ rule, test, filters }) =>
				rule.feed === feed && test.test(text) && filters(text)

(raw: string, commands: Command[]): Rule[] => [
	...hits(raw, "raw"),
	...commands.flatMap((c) => parsedTexts(c).flatMap((t) => hits(t, "parsed"))),
]
